en.description:
Trivia Questions and Answers delivers thousands of unique, stimulating, and mind-challenging questions across various categories. Test your knowledge and see how many you can answer correctly!

Perfect for:
•  Family game nights
•  Trivia competitions (pub quizzes, knowledge bowls, bar trivia)
•  Sharpening your own knowledge.

Key Features:
•  Thousands of questions spanning numerous topics.
•  Intuitive, user-friendly design. No account setup—start playing instantly!
•  Track your progress in each category. Can you conquer them all?
•  Get daily trivia with optional notifications.
•  Optimized for all Apple devices, including iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, Apple TV, and Mac.
•  iCloud sync to seamlessly track your progress across devices.
•  Customizable color themes and full dark mode support.
•  Easily share intriguing questions with friends.

Don’t forget to explore Trivia Questions and Answers on your Apple Watch and Apple TV!

Categories Include:
Health & Medicine, Geography, History, Sports, Technology, Movies, Literature, Commander in Chief, Math & Science, General Knowledge, Video Games, Music, Alter Egos, Who Invented It?, Television, Mythology, Animals.

Sample Questions:
•  What was the first item sold on eBay?
•  Which part of the body is most sensitive to radiation?
•  What does the “Q” in Q-tip stand for?
•  Which city had the world’s first paved streets?
•  Which country has the oldest national flag?
en.subtitle: Original Trivia Questions
